title: youpoli
description:
There is an abundance of bots present on major social media platforms of today, especially twitter.

Tracking the effectiveness of social media ads is difficult but this can be maximised by reaching as many real humans as possible. Advertisers don't want their ads to reach deaf ears like bots.
youpoli solves this problem by providing a platform for real users to share their real thoughts! For the advertiser this means better effectiveness of their ads.
We also provide analytics on the ads posted and how they can improve their product too based on short surveys [WIP]

For a general user like you and me, social media this means abundant spam and a highly biased feed based on the kind of content which is spammed more by bots.

On youpoli, you can avoid this and interact with real humans and share your real thoughts!

From "You People" comes the name "youpoli"
